Witch's Bottle.name: Witch's Bottle
Witch's Bottle.description: You Cast a Spell with the hex trait on the triggering target. If the spell you chose required two actions to be cast, you become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn, or @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} if the spell you chose required three actions. If the hex spell requires a @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain} to remain in effect, you must Sustain the Spell as normal on your next turn or the spell ends.

Demand Compliance.name: Demand Compliance
Demand Compliance.description:
You shout a demand at the target and gesture in tandem. You can give a demand to the target to spend a single action to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, pick up an item, drop prone, or stand in place. The effect lasts as long as the spell remains active or until the target completes the designated action, after which the spell immediately ends.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a -1 status penalty to attack rolls, saves, and skill checks until the beginning of their next turn and the spell immediately ends.

Failure The target takes a -1 status penalty to attack rolls, saves, and skill checks as long as the spell is active.

Critical Failure As failure, except the status penalty is -2.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.ol19i2os5AZkL6gf]{Spell Effect: Demand Compliance}

Nudge Fate+.name: Nudge Fate+
Nudge Fate+.description: The barest spin of your patron's spool is enough to alter fate. Once during the duration, when the target rolls an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw and a +1 status bonus would turn a critical failure into a failure, a failure into a success, or a success into a critical success, you grant the target a +1 status bonus to the check retroactively, changing the outcome appropriately. The spell then ends.

Warped Visage.name: Warped Visage
Warped Visage.description:
You warp the visage of the target to become an unrecognizable and hideous version of itself. The creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for the duration. The first time you Sustain the spell each turn, one of the target creature’s allies within 30 feet of the target must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.spellDC.value)] or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}; or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure. A creature targeted by this effect is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} and creatures do not treat the target as an ally while frightened.

Famed Figure.name: Famed Figure
Famed Figure.description:
You create an illusion of a creature from one of your stories. You create an illusory image of a Medium or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 30 feet apart or you Cast this spell again, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows. In combat, the illusion gains 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Cast the spell or the first time you Sustain the spell on subsequent turns. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC - 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[(1+@item.rank)d4[mental]] damage if it was a melee spell attack roll or @Damage[(@item.rank)d4[mental]] damage if it was a ranged spell attack roll. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal, its ranged attacks have a range of 30 feet, and if it makes more than one attack per turn, it takes a multiple attack penalty as if it were a creature. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell.

Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion. Any creature that touches the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion or if the spell ends while the illusion is observed, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's melee and ranged Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of the creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).

Autonomous Actor.name: Autonomous Actor
Autonomous Actor.description:
You know your familiar can operate with or without you, so you instead enhance its abilities. Your familiar gains 2 actions from its independent familiar ability for the duration.

Heightened (4th) Once during the duration, your familiar can use an action that would normally require you to give it a Command, using the actions it gains from independent to use this ability.

Mark of Mystery.name: Mark of Mystery
Mark of Mystery.description:
You branch the connection of your hexmarked nature to an ally. The target ally also gains your mark of the patron somewhere on its person, allowing you to use your ally's position when determining your mark’s effects as well as your own.

In addition, when creatures target you or an ally with a harmful effect while the spell is active, they must attempt a Will save. Creatures that fail their save become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} if it was a critical failure. Regardless of the result, a creature that succeeds its save or is no longer frightened by your mark is immune to this effect for 1 hour. Creatures of a type associated with your tradition listed below take a -1 status penalty to their saves against your effect and mindless creatures are not immune to the frightened condition from being mindless, though they may be immune for other reasons. This penalty also applies to spellcasters and dragons of your associated tradition.

  • Arcane beast, construct, elemental
  • Divine celestial, fiend, monitor, undead
  • Occult aberration, astral, ethereal, ooze, spirit
  • Primal animal, beast, elemental, fey, fungus, plant

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.0MYmoIO5mSb6QBFm]{Spell Effect: Mark of Mystery (Status Penalty)}

Familiar Lesson.name: Familiar Lesson
Familiar Lesson.description: You and your familiar join minds to discover something and then your familiar acts. You and your familiar attempt to Recall Knowledge on the same subject, and then you Command your familiar.

Accursed Formation.name: Accursed Formation
Accursed Formation.description: You've learned how to use your hexing magic to bind protections, hazards, and blockades. You can target a spell you have cast with a duration of at least 1 minute that creates a physical barrier, object, structure, or hazard, such as a healing well or a wall of thorns, and that spell lasts until your next daily preparations. When you do so, you can imbue your accursed formation with one of your hexes that targets a creature by spending a number of additional actions casting this spell equal to the number of actions to cast the chosen hex, spreading these actions across multiple rounds if necessary. Creatures that take damage or are otherwise affected by your accursed formation are subject to the hex in addition to the normal effects of the spell. The hex effects continue each turn they are affected by the target spell as if you had Sustained the spell, and your hex ends normally if not Sustained. If the hex you chose required a Focus Point to cast, you must spend 2 Focus Points to cast this spell and you cannot regain Focus Points spent to cast this spell until the spell you chose ends, is Dismissed, or otherwise is ended by its complete destruction. You can continue to spend appropriate spell slots and Focus Points during your daily preparations to keep your formation in place and you do not have to be in range of the hexed formation to do so.

Binding Summon.name: Binding Summon
Binding Summon.description: You bind the summoned creature to this realm, allowing it to fight by your side as a real creature. You no longer have to Sustain the spell for the summoned creature to remain summoned, and the spell lasts until your next daily preparations instead of the normal duration. When you Cast binding summon, you cannot regain the Focus Point spent to Cast the Spell until the spell that summoned the creature is dismissed or the target dies. The summoned creature gains a single action it can use during your turn even if you do not Sustain the spell. The creature cannot perform activities that take longer than 1 minute to perform otherwise the binding becomes unstable and the spell immediately ends.

Secret of the Forebearers.name: Secret of the Forebearers
Secret of the Forebearers.description: When you cast this hex, you create afterimages of previous witches that trail behind you and pass on their secrets. Once per turn for the duration, your forebearers @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} you on an attack roll or skill check, and can roll using your modifier in the skill granted by your patron instead of the normal skill check. If they roll a failure, they get a success instead. If you are legendary in the skill granted by your patron, they automatically critically succeed. In addition, whenever you succeed at a check that was aided by your forebearers, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} by their afterimages until the beginning of your next turn. You can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

Conjure Gadget.name: Conjure Gadget
Conjure Gadget.description:
You conjure a gadget to be equipped by you or an ally. You can summon a gadget whose formula your familiar knows and with an item level equal to the rank of this spell or lower that takes 2 actions or less to Activate. This gadget appears ready to be Activated by the target in its appropriate usage case and remains as long as you Sustain the spell. The target must be able to satisfy the usage case, such as having the required number of hands to hold the item, or the spell automatically fails. After this spell ends, the target becomes temporarily immune to conjure gadget for 10 minutes.

Heightened (7th) You can select up to two targets when you Cast this Spell.

Grant Wish.name: Grant Wish
Grant Wish.description:
You grant the creature the ability to speak aloud a small wish, but the way it is granted is not straightforward. During its turn, a creature can speak aloud a wish as a free action with the linguistic and auditory traits to give its next action or activity that requires an attack roll or a skill check a +1 status bonus to a single attack roll or skill check of its choice for that action or activity.

However, your patron corrupts the wish as you grant it, sapping its life and bringing it closer to death. If the creature fails the check they applied the bonus to, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase their drained value by 1 if they were already drained. The drained condition from this spell is temporary and only lasts the duration of the spell instead of the normal amount of time but removing the drained condition does not restore any Hit Points lost as normal for the drained condition.

Heightened (7th) The status bonus increases to +2.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.i4AhIPLETqNqStN7]{Spell Effect: Grant Wish}

Sudden Outbreak.name: Sudden Outbreak
Sudden Outbreak.description:
You cause a sudden turn for the worst in a target creature. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target must attempt a save against the DC of one of its diseases to progress to the next stage (target's choice) and then the spell immediately ends.

Failure As success, except the target must attempt a save to progress to the next stage of one of its diseases (target's choice) the first time you Sustain the spell on subsequent turns. If a creature gets a critical success at its save to progress to the next stage, this spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the spell does not end when a creature critically succeeds at its save to progress one of its diseases.

Evil Eye+.name: Evil Eye+
Evil Eye+.description: Your patron's resentment manifests in a baleful, envious gaze. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} if it fails a Will save (or sickened 2 on a critical failure). The target's sickened condition lasts until the end of your next turn, and you extend the duration to the end of your next turn each time you Sustain the spell. The sickened value can't be reduced below 1 while the spell is active and you can see the target.

Aura of Violent Light.name: Aura of Violent Light
Aura of Violent Light.description:
You imbue vitality into the creature, granting it brilliance and imbuing it with powerful spirit energy. The creature radiates bright light in an aura with a 5-foot emanation (and dim light for the next 5 feet). On subsequent turns, the first time each round you Sustain the spell, you increase the emanation by 5 feet up to a maximum of 15 feet.

While illuminated, the ally radiates powerful energy that deals @Damage[(1+@item.level)[fire],(1+@item.level)[spirit]] damage to all enemies that end their turn within the bright light of the emanation (basic Fortitude save).

Heightened (+1) The fire and spirit damage each increase by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.bRjQx1Kqy70IDcss]{Spell Effect: Aura of Violent Light}

Personal Blizzard+.name: Personal Blizzard+
Personal Blizzard+.description:
Your patron's breath becomes blizzard of obscuring, scouring ice that follows your target. The target attempts a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[1d6[cold]] damage, and the spell ends.

Failure The target takes @Damage[1d6[cold]] damage and @Damage[1d6[persistent,cold]] damage. The persistent damage automatically ends when the spell ends. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to other creatures, and other creatures are concealed to it.

Critical Failure As failure, but both the cold damage and the persistent cold damage increase to 2d6.

Heightened (+2) The cold damage increases by 1d6 and the persistent cold damage increases by 2 (2d6 and 4 on a critical failure).

Beguile.name: Beguile
Beguile.description:
You call out to the target with an enchanting voice or illusion of a face or by offering the target an irresistible gift. Choose voice or appearance and this spell gains the auditory or visual trait respectively.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you for 1 round after which the spell ends.

Failure The target is fascinated by you and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} if you chose appearance, or fascinated and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} if you chose voice. These effects last until the spell ends or until you take a hostile action against the creature or its allies.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target cannot take hostile actions against you and must attempt an additional Will save at the beginning of each of its turns it is fascinated. If it fails, it must Step or Stride towards you as its first action for the turn. If the creature is already adjacent to you, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn.

Coiling Creepers.name: Coiling Creepers
Coiling Creepers.description:
You summon twisting growths made of materials suitable to your patron, like briars, shadows or pictures from a book. When you Cast the Spell, and each time you Sustain the spell, the coiling creepers make an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} a creature in the area or an adjacent square using your spell attack roll modifier. The coiling creepers cannot leave the area and are treated as a Large creature for the purposes of determining what creatures it can make Athletics checks against. If you Sustain the spell multiple times in a round, you gain this effect each time. The coiling creepers use your multiple attack penalty. Squares filled with coiling creepers are difficult terrain. Each square can be cleared of coiling creepers by a single attack or effect that deals at least @Damage[(10+(@item.rank -3)*5)[slashing]] damage or @Damage[(2+@item.rank -3)[fire]] damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws. The coiling creepers don't grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The coiling creepers can't make any other attacks other than the specified Athletics maneuvers.

Heightened (+1) The slashing damage is increased by 5 and the fire damage is increased by 1.

Spirit's Touch.name: Spirit's Touch
Spirit's Touch.description:
You command the surrounding spirits to protect the creature. The first time each turn the creature would take physical damage, it can choose to reduce the damage by [[/r 3+2*(@item.rank -1)]]. While under the effects of this spell, the creature must attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:5|immutable:true] whenever they take the Interact action or the action is lost, as their metaphysical form prevents interaction with reality. The target rolls the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied. This hex effect cannot trigger more than once per round per instance of the hex.

Heightened (+1) The damage reduced increases by 2.

Specular Portals.name: Specular Portals
Specular Portals.description:
With a wave of your hand, you liquefy the surfaces of all reflective materials within your vicinity, allowing you to walk through one and leave through another. Any surface that could bear a visible reflection (such as a mirror, shiny metal or water) becomes a doorway that you can pass through. You may enter through one, and appear in the space of another within the area of the spell as if it were an adjacent space. Passing through a reflective surface in this way costs the same amount of movement as it would to walk through any other space. If the space is not large enough for your body (such as a coin), it costs an extra action to leave it as you push your way out of the impossible space. Other creatures may move through this space so long as the hex is active.

@Template[type:burst|distance:120]

Protective Visitation.name: Protective Visitation
Protective Visitation.description:
Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points from a critical hit or a critically failed save that dealt damage to you.

Your familiar moves into action immediately. Your familiar Strides towards you. If it ends this Stride in your space, you treat the critical hit as a normal hit or a critically failed save as a normal save, and your familiar takes damage equal to the same amount you take after reducing the effect.

Chant.name: Chant
Chant.description:
By speaking the words of the spell rhythmically and in sequence, you can spread its effects to those who can hear. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has the hex trait and targets a single creature with a duration dependent on Sustain, you can instead target all allies or enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. When you do so, that hex gains the auditory trait and creatures only remain affected while within the area. Creatures that enter the area after you Cast the Spell are not affected by your chant and creatures that leave the emanation do not regain its effects if they enter the area with temporary immunity. When you Sustain the hex, your Sustain gains the auditory trait and the emanation remains in effect. If you cast a chant again, the hex you targeted with your previous chant immediately ends for all creatures and any ongoing effects from your previous chant end immediately.

If your spell produces an active effect against a single target when you Cast or Sustain the hex, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vhMCd15ZwNJn0zen]{Malicious Shadow}, you choose one target under the effects of the hex in the emanation to be the target of the effect each time you Sustain.

Heightened (+2) The emanation increases by 5 feet.

Foundry Quick Templates

  • 5th Rank @Template[type:emanation|distance:35]
  • 7th Rank @Template[type:emanation|distance:40]
  • 9th Rank @Template[type:emanation|distance:45]

Eternal Slumber.name: Eternal Slumber
Eternal Slumber.description:
You cause the target to fall into a deep slumber, unable to wake itself. The creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes drowsy and takes a -2 status penalty to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and must attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:5] to use concentrate actions, losing the action on a failure.

Failure The target creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} for the duration and the creature does not automatically wake up under the circumstances that would cause them to wake unless they succeed at a Will save.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature remains unconscious permanently even after the spell ends. You can set a condition that will end this effect, but otherwise the unconscious condition can be removed only through @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}, or other powerful magic.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.uUfYWgmWGTQnVcmr]{Spell Effect: Eternal Slumber}

Holding Glyph.name: Holding Glyph
Holding Glyph.description:
An ancient glyph marks the target creature, causing it to be anchored to the ground. The target takes 1d4 force damage and additional effects depending on its Fortitude save. The creature attempts a Fortitude save when you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain the spell on subsequent rounds, suffering the listed effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and the spell immediately ends.

Success The target takes half damage and takes a -1 status penalty against forced movement effects.

Failure The target takes the full damage and takes a -2 status penalty against forced movement effects. In additon, each time the creature takes an action with the move trait, it takes 1 force damage.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target takes double the initial force damage and double the force damage when it uses an action with the move trait.

Heightened (+1) The initial force damage increases by 1d4 and the force damage on using actions with the move trait increases by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.7NepB112jMNylpkX]{Spell Effect: Holding Glyph}

Fabled Familiar.name: Fabled Familiar
Fabled Familiar.description:
In your time of need, your familiar inspires you. You Command your familiar and it gains a +1 status bonus to its next roll until the end of your next turn. If your familiar is adjacent to another creature, it can choose to bestow this bonus to that creature's next roll instead, but it must choose to do so at the time you Cast the Spell.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.GPiEnqwyDab4goUM]{Spell Effect: Fabled Familiar}

Cosmic Tune.name: Cosmic Tune
Cosmic Tune.description:
You grant an ally within 30 feet the ability to hear your cosmic song within their mind. The ally gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and to Will saves, but they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the music for the duration and hostile actions do not end the fascinated condition.

Heightened (7th) The status bonus increases to +2.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.CEp7ZWZ2MJKljoC8]{Spell Effect: Cosmic Tune}

Patron's Apocalypse.name: Patron's Apocalypse
Patron's Apocalypse.description: You wave your hand in the sky, beckoning in the end of the world as foreseen by your patron. You select up to four non-overlapping @Template[type:burst|distance:10] at any point within range, even in the air. These become points of the apocalypse, and creatures that begin their turn in the area take the listed damage and effects of the apocalypse envisioned by your patron. When you Sustain the spell, you can move one of these bursts up to 30 feet, leaving hazardous terrain in the previous area that deals 10 damage of the same type as the spell would deal and applying the additional effects for creatures within the area of the spell. You select the type of apocalypse envisioned by your patron when you first take the Lesson of Apocalypses. This spell gains the trait associated with the damage type of your choice.

Discern Secrets+.name: Discern Secrets+
Discern Secrets+.description:
Your patron degins to whisper a few secrets. The target can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} as a free action. The target gains a +1 status bonus to the statistic used for the roll (a skill or Perception), as long as you Sustain the spell.

Alternatively, you can target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature to remove the concealed condition as long as you Sustain the spell. If the creature's concealment is the result of a spell or effect, you can attempt a counteract check to remove the concealed condition, but all other effects of the spell remain and the concealed condition returns if the effect is still active when you end this spell.

Heightened (5th) You can target two creatures instead of one.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.hdOb5Iu6Zd3pHoGI]{Spell Effect: Discern Secrets (Recall Knowledge)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.m1tQTBrolf7uZBW0]{Spell Effect: Discern Secrets (Seek)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.dEsaufFnfYihu5Ex]{Spell Effect: Discern Secrets (Sense Motive)}

Sensory Deprivation.name: Sensory Deprivation
Sensory Deprivation.description:
You warp an illusion around the creature's eyes, mouth, or hands, that prevents them from acting normally.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success Choose eyes, hands, or mouth. The target creature feels a strange warmth and the inability to use certain actions, as their eyes, hands, or mouth are restricted by false illusions for 1 round. The creature can spend a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to disbelieve the effect as an illusion.

  • Eyes The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.
  • Hands The creature cannot take actions with the manipulate trait.
  • Mouth The creature cannot take actions with the auditory trait.

Failure As success, except the spell lasts the duration.

Critical Failure As failure, except you can choose two options instead of one.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.RWiUXoxDqN5HTBVZ]{Spell Effect: Sensory Deprivation}

Realityflicker.name: Realityflicker
Realityflicker.description:
You randomly assault the target with overwhelming curses from multiple realities that end and begin within moments, dealing 1d4 force damage and a randomly selected condition depending on their Will save. The creature attempts a Will save when you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain the spell on subsequent rounds, suffering the listed effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes 1d4 damage, and then rolls [[/r 1d4]] and gains the following condition until the end of its next turn.

  1. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.
  2. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.
  3. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.
  4. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, your choice.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and rolls [[/r 2d4]]. If they would get the same condition twice, you can treat the second result as if they had rolled a 4.

Heightened (+2) The damage increaes by 1d4.

Unleash True Power.name: Unleash True Power
Unleash True Power.description: Your eyes burst with light and you begin to float as you embrace your destiny as written by your patron. When you Cast this spell, you may immediately cast another spell with a cast time of 2 actions or less as a single action as your patrons cast directly through you. When you do so, you take @Damage[1d6[spirit]] damage per rank of the spell as fate itself pulls at your life (basic Fortitude). Spells you cast while this hex is active are heightened by one spell rank, up to a maximum of 10th-rank. The first time you Sustain the spell each turn, you can Cast another spell of 2 actions or less as a single action, suffering the damage each time you Cast a Spell this way. When this spell ends, you and all creatures in a 10-foot emanation take 10d6 spirit damage as a final shock of power surges through you with a basic Fortitude save.

Tidal Grasp.name: Tidal Grasp
Tidal Grasp.description:
Water rushes around the target's frame, encircling and restraining them with the force of the raging seas. When you Cast this hex, you make a spell attack roll against the target's Fortitude DC. If successful, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by your tidal rings until the end of your next turn or until it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(2* @item.rank)[bludgeoning]] damage equal to twice the rank of the spell. When you Sustain the spell, you make another spell attack roll. If you critically fail your spell attack roll against the target or the target critically succeeds an Escape against its grabbed condition, they become temporarily immune to this spell for 1 minute.

Heightened (3rd) You may target Huge or smaller creatures with this spell.

Heightened (7th) You may target Gargantuan or smaller creatures with this spell.

Lost in the Crowd.name: Lost in the Crowd
Lost in the Crowd.description:
You wave a hand, clouding the vision of your target and making them see their own face on everyone around them, and hear their own voice in a strange language. The creature attempts a Will save when you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain the spell each round, suffering the listed effects.

Critical Success The spell immediately ends.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target cannot tell who is their ally or their enemy. The target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you and they treat all creatures as enemies for the purpose of determining flanking for 1 round. The creature can spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.tikhJ2b6AMh7wQU7]{Seek} allies making a Perception check against your spell DC, and treating them as allies again on a success.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is off-guard to your allies in addition to you.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.5pJPytUOLY85MIZr]{Spell Effect: Lost in the Crowd}

Judge Soul.name: Judge Soul
Judge Soul.description:
Your word is final when you judge the souls of others. Choose a target in range. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead. The target takes 6d6 void damage or 6d6 vitality damage if it has void healing along with the listed effects depending on its save. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this spell dies or is destroyed permanently if it was undead and the target can't be returned to life or unlife through any means, except for powerful magic such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual. The creature attempts a Fortitude save when you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain the spell on subsequent rounds, suffering the listed effects.

All creatures who die or are destroyed by this spell become shades in the realm of your patron. If you have Cast this spell at least once that resulted in the death of another, when you die you are reincarnated as a celestial, fiend, elemental, hag, or other entity appropriate to your patron. As per usual rules, you likely only remember your past life like a dream in this way.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and the spell ends.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, then the spell ends.

Failure The target takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increases its drained value by 1 if it was already drained.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} or increases its drained value by 2 if it was already drained.

Devoted Glory.name: Devoted Glory
Devoted Glory.description:
Trigger Your familiar would attempt a save against an effect from a creature that violates your anathema.

Your faith grants you protection so that your story can continue. Your familiar rolls the save twice and uses the better result.

Brief Lesson.name: Brief Lesson
Brief Lesson.description:
You temporarily flood the target's mind with information and experience, as if they have been studying the topic at hand for years. You grant the target trained proficiency in a skill you are also proficient in and also grant them a +1 status bonus to checks with that skill. If the target would attempt a task or activity that lasts beyond this spell's duration, use the lower proficiency modifier. The target of your spell must be able to hear you and your Sustain action gains the auditory trait when you use it to Sustain this spell.

Heightened (6th) The target gains expert proficiency in the chosen skill and the status bonus to checks with that skill increases to +2.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.MQKO63AMAJ2Z1Rai]{Spell Effect: Brief Lesson}

Elemental Betrayal+.name: Elemental Betrayal+
Elemental Betrayal+.description:
Your patron uses its superior command of the elements, empowering them to undermine your foe. When you Cast this Spell, choose air, earth, metal, fire, water, or wood. The target gains weakness 2 to that trait.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.iYbOvjKFURLKJQ49]{Spell Effect: Elemental Betrayal+}

Heightened (+1) Increase the weakness by 1.

Melodious Provocateur.name: Melodious Provocateur
Melodious Provocateur.description: Your familiar adds its own touch to one of your performances, making it that much harder to break. You Command your familiar and Perform so that one observer of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7LB00jkh6JaJr3vS]{Fascinating Performance} becomes fascinated. You need only get a success instead of a critical success to succeed if you are in an encounter for your Fascinating Performance, and if your familiar aids you with its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.92lgSEPFIDLvKOCF]{Accompanist} familiar ability, only your hostile actions end the fascination as long as it aids your Performs. Each time you Sustain the spell, you Perform and then give your familiar a Command.

Lurking Doom.name: Lurking Doom
Lurking Doom.description:
You spur the creation of dark futures within the mind's eye of your target. These images deal 1d4 mental damage and make it difficult to concentrate, depending on its Will save. The creature attempts a Will save when you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain the spell on subsequent rounds, suffering the listed effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and the spell immediately ends.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and if the target attempts a concentrate action, it must succeed at a @Check[type:flat|dc:5|immutable:true] or it is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Ravaging End.name: Ravaging End
Ravaging End.description:
You bring forth a manifestation of the end to one enemy you can see. When you Cast this Spell, choose either acid, fire, or poison and the spell gains the trait you chose and deals 1d4 damage plus 2 persistent damage of the same type. The persistent damage automatically ends when the spell ends and it can still be removed with a DC 15 flat check, but it cannot be removed automatically with assistance while the spell is active.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage.

Critical Failura The target takes double damage and the flat check to remove the persistent damage is DC 17.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage by 2.

Needle of Vengeance+.name: Needle of Vengeance+
Needle of Vengeance+.description:
A long, jagged needle jabs into the target foe's psyche whenever it tries to attack a creature your patron holds in special regard. Name yourself or one of your allies. The target takes @Damage[2[mental]] damage any time it uses a hostile action against the named creature, with a basic Will save. On a critical failure, the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} the first time it uses a hostile action against the named creature for the duration of the spell.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by @Damage[2[mental]]{2 mental}.

Swamp Emergence.name: Swamp Emergence
Swamp Emergence.description:
You turn the designated area (4 continguous 5-foot squares) into murky bogland. You cause a swamp to sputter out of the floor in the chosen area, complete with thick overgrowth that is 5 feet tall, and a foot thick, providing lesser cover. When you Sustain the spell, you can add up to 4 additional contiguous squares in any direction that must be adjacent to another square of your swamp emergence.

Heightened (3rd) The overgrowth provides standard cover.

Heightened (7th) The overgrowth provides greater cover.

Soothsayer's Prediction.name: Soothsayer's Prediction
Soothsayer's Prediction.description:
You look into the future, gaining glimpses of what is to come. You gain a vague description of the next creature you are likely to encounter. The next time you engage in combat and roll for initiative, make an immediate Recall Knowledge against one creature in the encounter you can see and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your roll. You use your spellcasting tradition's associated skill instead of the normal skill associated with that creature. After you make this check, the spell ends. These benefits last for the duration and you cannot regain the Focus Point you spent to cast this spell until the duration has expired.

@UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.M0c7Yr4QtW6CenS7]{Spell Effect: Soothsayer's Prediction}
